description: Defines the SourceDir class which represents a directory within the source tree, including methods for resolving relative paths, checking path types, and handling source directory paths.

classes.name: SourceDir
classes.description: Represents a directory within the source tree with methods for path resolution and analysis.

methods.name: SourceDir(std::string_view s)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes SourceDir with a string view.

methods.name: ResolveRelativeAs
methods.description: Resolves a file or directory name relative to this source directory, with options for error handling and source root.

methods.name: ResolveRelativeFile
methods.description: Resolves a relative file path based on the source directory.

methods.name: ResolveRelativeDir
methods.description: Resolves a relative directory path based on the source directory.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves the source directory relative to a given source root, returning a file path.

methods.name: is_null
methods.description: Checks if the source directory path is empty.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the string value of the source directory path.

methods.name: is_source_absolute
methods.description: Checks if the path is source-absolute (starts with //).

methods.name: is_system_absolute
methods.description: Checks if the path is system-absolute (starts with / but not //).

methods.name: SourceAbsoluteWithOneSlash
methods.description: Returns the source-absolute path starting with a single slash.

methods.name: SourceWithNoTrailingSlash
methods.description: Returns the path without a trailing slash.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Less-than comparison for ordering SourceDir objects.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Returns a hash value for the SourceDir object.
